'''Mobquet Swoops and Speeders''', also known as just '''Mobquet''', was a company owned by [[Tagge Company/Legends|TaggeCo]]. They built [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]], [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] and [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]], as their name might suggest. A popular landspeeder model they produced was the [[A-1 Deluxe Floater/Legends|A-1 Deluxe Floater]]. They also produced the [[Flare-P swoop]], the more advanced [[Flare-S swoop/Legends|Flare-S]] swoop and the powerful [[Nebulon-Q Swoop Racer|Nebulon-Q]] thruster jet. These speeders' success in the Core swoop-racing leagues enhanced the company's reputation. Mobquet also was the sponsor of the [[Mobquet Presents: Fastest Land Beings]] races on [[Teyr/Legends|Teyr]].

Mobquet also produced the [[MB-C1 medium transport]] owned by the [[smuggler]]s [[Salla Zend]] and [[Shug Ninx]] called the ''[[Starlight Intruder]]''.
